Honeypot Data

Live Cowrie SSH honeypot on AWS. Attacker credentials, commands, and captured malware samples, refreshed daily for anyone doing their own research or testing.

Back to Projects

What is this

A Cowrie SSH/Telnet honeypot runs on a small EC2 instance, exposed to the open internet on the standard-looking honeypot port. Everything below is real, unfiltered internet background noise: automated scanners and bots trying default and stolen credentials, and any malware they drop gets captured automatically.

Malware samples are zip-archived with the password infected (the standard malware-research convention) so nothing executes accidentally and archive scanners don't flag the page. Only unzip them in an isolated/disposable environment if you intend to analyze live malware.
